title: column_total breaks on quoted fields
label: base
prompt: column_total(text, index) in totals.py sums one column of CSV text, but it splits on commas so quoted fields containing commas break it and shift the column index. Fix it so quoted fields are handled correctly, keeping the current signature and return type. Make test_totals.py pass and run python -m pytest -q.

args.content:
"""Sum a numeric column of CSV text."""

import csv
from io import StringIO


def column_total(text, index):
    """Return the sum of column `index` over all data rows of `text`."""
    total = 0
    reader = csv.reader(StringIO(text.strip()))
    next(reader)  # skip header
    for row in reader:
        total += float(row[index])
    return total
